subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Toby is standing at the cryo board with his hands behind his back, reading the amber lights one at a time. "With respect, Roberta, there are forty-one amber now and there were thirty-nine at the last change, and I'd ask you to tell me plainly if any of the sleepers is in trouble, because they're mine to watch even while they sleep." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Two on the Watch). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
